extracted.name: Pickled Jalapeños and Carrots
extracted.description: These pickled jalapeños and carrots are super quick to make at home for a spicy condiment just like you'd get at a Mexican restaurant.
ingredient_lines: 0.5 red onion, cut into 1/4 inch-thick rings
instruction_lines: Place vinegar and sugar in a saucepan; cook and stir over medium heat until sugar has dissolved and mixture comes to a boil. Add jalapeños, carrots, and onion. Remove pan from the heat and let stand for 1 hour. Cool to room temperature before serving.
